concept.title: Beginners to dance and exercise
concept.shortdesc: People who are new to, or have only basic experience of, a physical activity such as dance, group exercise, Pilates, walking, running or strength training.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.
